title: Workspace page
summary: A page of side-by-side panes (a nav, a main pane and an optional aside) that each scroll on their own, built on pk-workspace: on a phone one pane shows at a time behind a tab strip. Set the mount(panes) callback as a property (business logic, never config data): it receives { nav, main, aside } (the panes that exist) and returns a cleanup function or a { destroy() } handle, which the element calls when it leaves the page. While mount() is pending the built-in loading state shows, and a rejection shows the error state with Retry.

props.name: config
props.description: { panes?, navLabel?, mainLabel?, asideLabel?, asideOpen?, label? }. panes lists the optional panes to create: any of 'nav' and 'aside' (default ['nav']; the main pane always exists). navLabel, mainLabel and asideLabel are the panes' accessible names and phone tabs (pk-workspace's own defaults otherwise). asideOpen is true unless set to false. label names the loading state. Optional title bar from the shared page shell: heading?: string, breadcrumb?: [{ label, href? }], actions?: [{ key, label, href?, variant? }] (an action without href fires pk-action). Nothing is drawn when none is set.

props.name: fill
props.description: Take all the room a flex column parent leaves (the panes then scroll instead of the page). Without it the page has pk-workspace's default height.

events.name: pk-action
events.description: A title-bar action (config.actions entry without an href) was clicked.

parts.name: header
parts.description: The shared title bar: a pk-page-header with the breadcrumb and actions from config. Hidden when config sets none of them.

parts.name: frame
parts.description: Positions the state overlay so it covers the panes but never the title bar.

parts.name: workspace
parts.description: The pk-workspace that lays out the panes.

parts.name: nav
parts.description: The nav pane's content; mount() draws into it.

parts.name: main
parts.description: The main pane's content; mount() draws into it.

parts.name: aside
parts.description: The aside pane's content; mount() draws into it.

parts.name: state
parts.description: Covers the panes with the loading or error state while mount() is in flight or failed.

a11y: pk-workspace names each pane (region, complementary, or a tab panel on a phone, with arrow-key navigation on the tab strip); the loading and error states use pk-skeleton and pk-alert's own roles and announcements.

examples.title: Files workspace (set config and mount from script: an inline script cannot run under this site's CSP, so wire it the way pk-tool-page's run is wired)
